text:
samir: Postmortem follow-up from the streaming/chat incident on 2026-03-10. Focus: timeouts -> partial responses + reconnect behavior. I summarized actions and owners below.

maya: Thanks — can we prioritize short fixes first (server timeout bump + client backoff) and then the deeper idempotency/stream resume work? :+1:

alex_g: Agreed. Quick wins: extend default streaming keepalive, make server send final chunk meta, and add simple client reconnect with dedupe token.

opsbot: Incident alert archived: INC-20260310-STREAM-HTTPOUT (root cause: upstream KV cache lock + slow kernel path under burst).

samir: Action items (owners + rough timelines):
- RW-3456 (Owner: maya) — bump streaming timeout from 10s -> 30s and add server-side keepalive pings. Target: 48h patch + canary in staging.
- RW-3457 (Owner: alex_g) — SDK: implement exponential backoff reconnect + idempotency token header `X-RW-Stream-Id`. Client should attempt transparent resume up to 3 times. Target: 1 week.
- RW-3458 (Owner: jing) — E2E: add synthetic load test that reproduces partial-response pattern (KV lock + long-tail seq). Add regression alert. Target: 2 weeks.
- RW-3459 (Owner: samir) — Monitoring: add metrics for `stream.partial_response_count`, `stream.resume_attempts`, and SLO dashboard. Target: 1 week.
- RW-3460 (Owner: maya) — Runtime change: make server annotate final chunk with `{"stream_status":"complete"}` so clients can detect truncation. Target: 2 weeks.

maya: For RW-3456 I'll open a PR with the keepalive flag and patch notes. Plan: feature flag on staging first, then enable for 10% of traffic in canary.

alex_g: For SDK change, design notes: use idempotency token per request; server accepts Resume-Offset header to skip already-acked tokens. Minimal change for now: dedupe on token and drop duplicate tokens on reconnect. Longer-term: streaming resumption with offset map. I'll link design doc in RW-3457.

jing: Test plan: create an integration that injects artificial kv lock latency to force partial send. We should assert that SDK resumes without duplicating tokens and that `stream.partial_response_count` drops after fixes.

samir: Prioritization: RW-3456 and RW-3457 = P0 immediate. RW-3459 + RW-3458 = P1. RW-3460 = P1 but required for robust detection.

maya: Risks: bumping timeouts increases resource hold time on Dedicated GPUs. We'll add a TTL on KV locks and observe. Also canary policy: 10% traffic for 24h then evaluate error/latency.

alex_g: Quick code snippet for client reconnect strategy (for SDK repo):
```
// pseudocode
let attempts = 0;
while (attempts < 3) {
  sock = openStream();
  sock.on('chunk', handleChunk);
  sock.on('close', () => {
    if (lastChunk.meta && lastChunk.meta.complete) break;
    attempts += 1;
    await backoff(attempts);
    sendResumeHeader(streamId, lastChunk.offset);
  });
}
```

maya: Note for runtime PR: add healthcheck to avoid holding GPU for staged requests longer than X. We should track downstream queue length.

samir: Postmortem follow-up process: we'll track these RW tickets in the incident Jira epic INC-STREAM-20260310. Owners should update the ticket status and mark block/unblock in the #incidents thread within 48h of changes.

opsbot: Reminder: weekly follow-up meeting scheduled: `#incidents` thread ping on 2026-03-18 10:00 (UTC) to review RW-* progress.

jing: Also seeing a recurring pattern: partial responses spike on 95th+ percentile seq length and when autoscaling events overlap with batch flush. Suggest separate investigation ticket after immediate fixes.

samir: Good point. New follow-up: RW-3461 (Owner: eng-platform) — investigate autoscale + batch flush race causing partial sends. Target: 3 weeks.

alex_g: I'll add SDK telemetry patch to report ``resume_attempted`` and ``duplicate_token_detected`` flags so we can measure client-side behavior post-rollout.

maya: I'll schedule the canary deployment for RW-3456 today and attach the metrics dashboard link once ready.

samir: Please add each RW- ticket to the incident epic and comment here when PRs are opened. We'll close this thread once all P0s are in canary and the monitoring shows improvement for 48h.

alex_g: PRs to open: RW-3457 (SDK) by EOD, RW-3459 (monitoring) by tomorrow.

jing: I'll start the E2E harness today and post initial results in this thread.

maya: Updated checklist:
- [ ] RW-3456 patch + canary (48h)
- [ ] RW-3457 SDK reconnect (1w)
- [ ] RW-3459 metrics/dashboard (1w)
- [ ] RW-3458 E2E tests (2w)
- [ ] RW-3460 final-chunk annotation (2w)
- [ ] RW-3461 autoscale investigation (3w)

samir: Thanks everyone. I'll run the follow-up meeting and escalate if any P0 misses deadline. :slightly_smiling_face:

opsbot: Next reminder in 7 days for open tickets in INC-STREAM-20260310.
